comment:
* A grouping of related notification channels. e.g., channels that all belong to a single account.
 *
 * Setters return {@code this} to allow chaining.
 *
 * This class doesn't do anything on older SDKs which don't support Notification Channels.

variables.name: mId
variables.comment: These fields are settable through the builder

methods.name: NotificationChannelGroup getNotificationChannelGroup()
methods.comment:
* Gets the platform notification channel group object.
     *
     * Returns {@code null} on older SDKs which don't support Notification Channels.

methods.name: public Builder toBuilder()
methods.comment: * Creates a {@link Builder} instance with all the writeable property values of this instance.

methods.name: public String getId()
methods.comment: * Gets the id of the group.

methods.name: public CharSequence getName()
methods.comment: * Gets the user visible name of the group.

methods.name: public String getDescription()
methods.comment: * Gets the user visible description of the group.

methods.name: public boolean isBlocked()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether or not notifications posted to {@link NotificationChannelCompat} belonging * to this group are blocked. This value is independent of * {@link NotificationManagerCompat#areNotificationsEnabled()} and * {@link NotificationChannelCompat#getImportance()}. * *

This value is always {@code false} before {@link Build.VERSION_CODES#P} * *

This is a read-only property which is only valid on instances fetched from the * {@link NotificationManagerCompat}.

methods.name: public List<NotificationChannelCompat> getChannels()
methods.comment:

This is a read-only property which is only valid on instances fetched from the * {@link NotificationManagerCompat}.
